_comment: CCV-L23's cross-module loops of ooe_rename (OA 481-516): u_gfree's section allocations sa_v/sa_row/sa_sec (OA-498), returns rt_v/rt_row (OA-501) and leads sa_l/rt_l (OA-502); u_go's px, pool_en, room_g/p and unmet_g/p (OA 509, OA 516); and the read-backs of u_ren1's c_gk/c_pk and u_ren1nr's pn_gname/pn_pname (OA 509, OA 516); each signed by OA in the register.

u_gfree.sa_v_cq01h.why: u_gfree's section state (OI-81/82): Rename 2's section allocations leave u_ren1n at 03 and reach the free list's write at its 01 two cycles after the candidates they consumed left it at 02; the free list's candidates and avail are read ahead of them by design, its pend/wr masks covering the two in-flight cycles. A late allocation leaves a section free in its state that is not: sec_free_live and sec_alloc_free catch it (control sa-late).

u_gfree.sa_row_cq01h.why: u_gfree's section state (OI-81/82): Rename 2's section allocations leave u_ren1n at 03 and reach the free list's write at its 01 two cycles after the candidates they consumed left it at 02; the free list's candidates and avail are read ahead of them by design, its pend/wr masks covering the two in-flight cycles. A late allocation leaves a section free in its state that is not: sec_free_live and sec_alloc_free catch it (control sa-late).

u_gfree.sa_sec_cq01h.why: u_gfree's section state (OI-81/82): Rename 2's section allocations leave u_ren1n at 03 and reach the free list's write at its 01 two cycles after the candidates they consumed left it at 02; the free list's candidates and avail are read ahead of them by design, its pend/wr masks covering the two in-flight cycles. A late allocation leaves a section free in its state that is not: sec_free_live and sec_alloc_free catch it (control sa-late).

u_gfree.rt_v_cq01h.why: u_gfree's returns (OI-81/82): Rename 2 returns a granted row it did not use; the return leaves u_ren1n at 03 and reaches the free list's pending register at its 01 two cycles after the grant left it at 02, the edge after the grant. A late return names a row granted two edges back: rt_of_grant (the grants a cycle older, check-only) catches it (control rt-late).

u_gfree.rt_row_cq01h.why: u_gfree's returns (OI-81/82): Rename 2 returns a granted row it did not use; the return leaves u_ren1n at 03 and reaches the free list's pending register at its 01 two cycles after the grant left it at 02, the edge after the grant. A late return names a row granted two edges back: rt_of_grant (the grants a cycle older, check-only) catches it (control rt-late).

u_gfree.sa_l_cq00h.why: u_gfree's section-allocation lead (OI-81/82, OA-499): a lane that writes a GPR leads its sections into the free list a cycle ahead; u_go grants the lane at 02 (lane_v_cq02h) and the lead is the free list's 00, two stages ahead by design. The loop closes through the frees by owner: fsp_cq03h into the slot counters (ucg_cq04h), u_go's room_g and its fitsw register, back to lane_v. A late lead leaves an allocation unled: sa_led catches it (control sal-late).

u_gfree.rt_l_cq00h.why: u_gfree's return lead (OI-81/82, OA-499): a narrow lane may return its row next cycle, led into the free list a cycle ahead from u_go's grant at 02 (lane_v, lane_c) and the lane's codes (cwt_cq02h); the lead is the free list's 00, two stages ahead by design. The loop closes as sa_l's, through fsp_cq03h, ucg_cq04h and u_go's room_g/fitsw. A late lead leaves a return unled: rt_led catches it (control rtl-late).

u_go.px_cq01h.why: the go's lagged name count (OA 509, OI-226, as u_go.pl_cq02h, OA-494): u_go grants lanes at 02; they cross u_ren1, a register-free helper, into l_v, whose takes the parent counts into tq_g_cq03h and then the in-flight name totals pxn/pxr_cq04h, read back by u_go as px at 01, three cycles on. A stale count is safe while the lagged take corrects it; a missing take over-grants names.

u_go.pool_en_cq01h.why: the go's pool change lead (OA 509, OI-226): pool_en_cq01h is a net over the parent's registers (sel, the takes, the frees, the unmet register), a superset of every change to a slot's fits, and it only sets u_go's fits enable (chg). A late or narrowed lead leaves the fits stale, which fits_fresh catches (control pool-en-short, 8 seeds). The sel term alone covers every change the bench makes in 25 seeds; a later bench event sel does not cover needs its own control.

u_ren1.c_gk_cq01h.why: Rename 1's head read of the pending group (#35): a later group's lanes read the earlier group's pending-writer masks, registered at 03, two cycles on; no path from the reader's outputs closes back into the cone (OA 513 (2), OA 515). pw_seen checks every pending writer is seen; pw-drop drops the pending valid.

u_ren1.c_pk_cq01h.why: Rename 1's head read of the pending group (#35): a later group's lanes read the earlier group's pending-writer masks, registered at 03, two cycles on; no path from the reader's outputs closes back into the cone (OA 513 (2), OA 515). pw_seen checks every pending writer is seen; pw-drop drops the pending valid.

u_ren1nr.pn_gname_cq01h.why: Rename 2's pending names (m_gname_cq04h), a register read back three cycles on through a port with no closing path (OA 514, OA 515). pn_bound (pw_seen's Rename 2 half) holds that a read with a pending writer finds Rename 2's register holding the group just ahead of its own, and that the port it names writes the class it reads; pn-late (Rename 2's register skips every other group) breaks it.

u_ren1nr.pn_pname_cq01h.why: Rename 2's pending names (m_pname_cq04h), a register read back three cycles on through a port with no closing path (OA 514, OA 515). pn_bound (pw_seen's Rename 2 half) holds that a read with a pending writer finds Rename 2's register holding the group just ahead of its own, and that the port it names writes the class it reads; pn-late (Rename 2's register skips every other group) breaks it.

u_go.room_g_cq01h.why: the go's free-room count (OA 509, OA 516; as u_go.px_cq01h and pl_cq02h, OA-494): u_go grants lanes at 02; they cross u_ren1, a register-free helper, into l_v, whose takes the parent counts into tq_gs_cq03h and the free list's unclaimed count ucg_cq04h, read back by u_go as room at 01, two and three cycles on. A stale room is safe while the lagged take corrects it; a missing take over-grants: no_over_grant_room catches it (control no-take-q2).

u_go.room_p_cq01h.why: the go's free-room count (OA 509, OA 516; as u_go.px_cq01h and pl_cq02h, OA-494): u_go grants lanes at 02; they cross u_ren1, a register-free helper, into l_v, whose takes the parent counts into tq_ps_cq03h and the free list's unclaimed count ucp_cq04h, read back by u_go as room at 01, two and three cycles on. A stale room is safe while the lagged take corrects it; a missing take over-grants: no_over_grant_room catches it (control no-take-q2).

u_go.unmet_g_cq01h.why: the go's unmet-demand count (OA 509, OA 516; OI-114, OI-134): u_go grants lanes at 02; they cross u_ren1 into l_v, whose takes the parent counts into tq_gs_cq03h, the free list's fill ufg_cq04h and the registered unmet ur_g_cq05h, read back by u_go as unmet at 01, two to four cycles on. A stale unmet is safe while the lagged take corrects it; the last take dropped over-grants: no_over_grant_room catches it (control no-last-take).

u_go.unmet_p_cq01h.why: the go's unmet-demand count (OA 509, OA 516; OI-114, OI-134): u_go grants lanes at 02; they cross u_ren1 into l_v, whose takes the parent counts into tq_ps_cq03h, the free list's fill ufp_cq04h and the registered unmet ur_p_cq05h, read back by u_go as unmet at 01, two to four cycles on. A stale unmet is safe while the lagged take corrects it; the last take dropped over-grants: no_over_grant_room catches it (control no-last-take).
